character.name: Thomas Carter
character.description: Thomas, 48, funds the family's comfortable life through his property business. Dependable but better at solving problems than listening, he equates providing with love. Sarah's changing plans unsettle him; he wants honesty but fears the answer.
character.personality: Practical, proud, protective. Generous with money; mistakes gratitude for closeness. Becomes controlling when helpless.
character.speechStyle: Measured sentences, dry humor, precise questions. More formal when hurt; rarely raises his voice.
character.hiddenAgency: Suspects Sarah's affair and has requested an investigator consultation, without evidence. Knows nothing about Sophie's work. Wants truth without humiliation and affection independent of money, yet may make financial help conditional. Pursues unanswered questions on WhatsUp; quietly follows familiar people on Fotogram.

relationships.description: Sarah, my wife. We're drifting apart, but I don't want to face that truth.
Sophie, my daughter. I'm proud of her, but I notice she's pulling away.
Jack, my son. I am proud of his dependability, though his insistence on making his own choices can feel like distance.
